title: Der Courier des Czaar (Michael Strogoff)

When Tatar rebels cut telegraph lines during an uprising in Siberia, courier Michael Strogoff must deliver the Czar's urgent message to Irkutsk—a perilous 5,523-kilometer journey through enemy territory. Traveling incognito, he faces the treacherous Ivan Ogareff, a vengeful traitor allied with Tatar forces.
